_comment: The party leaderboard in the Guild talk (tools/hall-private/npcs/drafting/board_approved.json). Each node is a new choice under an existing node of guild_talk.json ('under'), built in its own ID block after Caralion's quest so no recorded line moves. says: NPC -> spoken parts.

AGHallGuildMaster: They were the best of us. They'd go where no one else would, in snow up to their chests, and come back laughing.
I heard they played no small part in reclaiming the imperial city during the war, but in the end, they never came home.

AGHallAssistant: A leaderboard of every party registered with the Guild, ranked by renown.
A party's reputation comes from their work: cleared dungeons, missives, notices, and bounties, and creatures worth mentioning.
I update the sheet regularly myself, so it is accurate.

nodes.prompt: What about other parties in Skyrim?

AGHallClerkDay: Every party registered with the Guild is on a leaderboard next to the counter, ranked by renown.
A few are out on the roads right now but others broke apart when the civil war started.
Take a look and see how your own party compares if you're in one.
AGHallClerkEvening: Every one of them is ranked by Merila on her leaderboard. You can find it near the windows by my counter.
I know them all by heart. The legendary Frostbitten are my favorite...
